name: Graphite Lime
description: Operatsion dashboard uslubi: qoramtir grafit fon, lime aksentlar, yuqori kontrastli kartalar va texnik timeline. IT, engineering, monitoring va mahsulot metrikalari uchun.
prompt_guidance: Write concise operational insights with clear metrics, statuses, bottlenecks, and outcomes.
Prefer structured comparisons, dashboards, timelines, and measurable progress indicators.
Use direct technical language without marketing filler.
Use 1-2 table sections when the topic includes systems, metrics, stages, or operational categories.
Keep every fact short enough for high-contrast dashboard panels.
